A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Chev]] served as a '''scheduling secretary''' for [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] in [[44 ABY]]. The [[Secretary/Legends|secretary]] was present during a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Plan Delta|coup]] in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].<ref name="conviction" />
